newsitem.title: GERMANY: Germans seek free market wheat, barley, rye export.
newsitem.headline: Germans seek free market wheat, barley, rye export.

text.p: German grain traders placed bids for the export of 8,000 tonnes of free market wheat with rebates in a 13.79-15.69 Ecus a tonne range, state grain intervention board BLE said.
Traders participating in the European Union's weekly grain export tender also sought to export 11,000 tonnes of free market barley, where the range of restitutions was 27.90-30.90 Ecus per tonne.
Traders also bid for the export of 106,000 tonnes of free market rye, with the desired subsidy in a 28.99-41.99 Ecus a tonne range, BLE said.
